items.html: And these three were counted and explained here in the Idra Zuta: "Three heads are engraved, one within the other, and one above the other," and it began to explain them from below upward, and began with the lowest of them, which is the Hochma of AA. And it said, "one head is the concealed Hochma that is covered," etc.; and above it the second head, which is the Keter of AA, and corresponding to it said, "the holy upper head, the concealed Ancient of all concealments"; and above it the first and upper head of the three, which is called Atik Yomin, and corresponding to it said, "the head of every head, the head that is not a head, that is not known and does not know," etc.
